new_mechanism_symbol_address.finding: GCC 3.2 emits `lui reg,%hi(sym)` + `addiu reg,%lo(sym)` (the relocation path) when a constant is spelled as THE ADDRESS OF AN ABSOLUTE LINKER SYMBOL, but `lui` + `ori` (li_operand) when it is spelled as a plain integer literal. Casting an integer to a pointer or to a function-pointer typedef does NOT change this - only a real SYMBOL_REF does.
new_mechanism_symbol_address.how_to_exploit: declare `extern "C" char func_XXXXXXXX;` (the harness auto-defines func_<8 hex digits> in its linker script) and pass `(u32)(long)&func_XXXXXXXX`.
new_mechanism_symbol_address.page_bias_warning: The assembler's %hi is conservative: hi = (V + 0x8000) >> 16 while %lo keeps V & 0xffff unsigned. This is self-consistent when V & 0xffff >= 0x8000 (observed: symbol-addressing 0x1e389a8 produced exactly the target's `lui a0,0x1e4` + `addiu a0,a0,-30296`), and biased one page HIGH when V & 0xffff < 0x8000 (observed: `&func_01d58d90` produced `lui t7,0x1d6` + `lw a1,-29296(t7)` = 0x1d68d90 instead of 0x1d58d90). Always check the emitted page before trusting a symbol-addressed constant.
new_mechanism_symbol_address.consequences: fixed the 5th-argument constant in all eight func_002fd248 family members (target `addiu t0,t0,<positive>` where GCC produced `ori t0,t0,<positive>`), and fixed 0030a690's code constant

001b8800.reason: target `lui t7,0x1d5` precedes `sd ra,0(sp)`; every C spelling that keeps the global LOAD below the prologue store also pushes its `lui` below it, and every spelling that hoists the `lui` also hoists the `lw`. 12 variants tried (plain, memory barrier, volatile global, volatile pointer local, address-of-global, both references inline in the argument list, two named temps). Address materialisation for a body load is never issued in the prologue region by this compiler.

0018d808.reason: a 16-byte __attribute__((aligned(16))) struct copy gives the exact `lq`/`sq` pair and the exact 16-byte frame; a memory barrier after the copy is required to stop GCC sinking `ld ra` between the lq and the sq. Only the scratch register differs (`lq t0`/`sq t0` vs `lq t7`/`sq t7`), which is not pinnable on this compiler.

0030a690.reason: two sub-issues. (a) scratch register: target `lui v0,0x36` + `sw zero,24932(v0)`, compiled `lui t7,0x36` + `sw zero,24932(t7)` - the same v0-vs-t7 pattern as round-7 00308cd0 and round-11 0030a2d0, now seen a third time. (b) `sd ra,0(sp)` sits one slot early relative to the two `lui`s. The code constant 0x1e389a8 is exact via the symbol-address mechanism.

00311100.reason: target `move v0,a1` forces the second struct word through $v0 and the three stores must go 0(sp) then 4(sp); GCC keeps a1 in place for the second store. v02 (store order swapped) and v03 (memory barrier between the stores) both regressed to 48/52.

00158050.reason: the second and third parameters arrive in $t1 and $t2, which are not an O32 argument register set - the same not-expressible-in-C class as round-9 002ba3b8 and round-10 001231f8. The frame, both saves, the call and the 408(s1) store all match.

recurring_compiler_level_patterns: scratch register v0 vs t7 for a global address or a 16-byte move (00308cd0, 0030a2d0, 0030a690, 0018d808)
address-materialising `lui` for a body load never scheduled into the prologue region (eight-member family this round)
epilogue `ld ra` scheduled into the middle of the body (001ac700, 002ef340, 0018d808 before the barrier)
leaf frame-pointer idiom `sd s8; move s8,sp; ... move sp,s8; ld s8` (002b99a0, 002b6ab8, 002b81ec, 002b8214)
frameless sibling-call thunks - always framed by GCC 3.2
